requested_scope: Owner-authorized C5 source after honest scoped C4 review; qualification remains deferred

criteria.rationale: Fourteen derived requirements allocate original IMP parents/F50-F53 to twenty unrun future cases; source allocation only.
Concrete bounded IR/scenario/native correspondence/lifecycle and owner facade are defined; full numerical/advanced/C6/backend compatibility remains open.
One flat IR/compiler, one optional established ODE adapter and one owner store; avoid arbitrary scripts/general agents/custom unqualified solver.
Original source/model cuts and assumptions preserved; conditional simulation, finite scenario range and unsealed comparison status explicit in source.
Finite byte/cell/grammar/RHS/time/worker/storage/control reservations coded; no hard native deadline, scale/HA/energy or complete path result.
Durable run intent, cancellation, original-result retry and explicit-attempt fencing coded; crashes/full disk/concurrency/restore remain unrun.
Saved SciPy preference reused and pinned official API checked; model/compiler correspondence and lifecycle are EDI code; no new numerical advantage claimed.
Only AST/import/parser/JSON/TOML/link/inventory/schema artifact checks; no compiler/solver/store/scenario/product execution.

c4_prerequisite.supported_subset: C0-mediated bounded proposal/test context; no direct C4-C5 execution dependency

skills.name: edi-component-review
skills.scope: KISS/Five Whys/waterfall/MECE/failure/requirement/operating-envelope assessment; product/gate execution deferred by owner

skills.name: edi-interface-review
skills.scope: all 56 directions, eleven facets and shared-state/feedback/recovery review

findings.detail: Pin native participants, versions, admission, dependency completeness and stock/flow inventories before numerical support.
Reject ignored operator fields, incompatible units/cycles, duplicate native transfers and hidden resource/history mechanisms.
Preserve exact source statement/correction status; numeric trial state never writes world/evidence state.
Segment explicit driver changes without stock reset; nonfinite/negative rate/domain/bound failure yields partial/failed output.
Retain generated origin/unsealed forecast and label finite ranges/secants without causal or posterior claims.
Reserve final-result/control space at run intent; cancel/finalize do not depend on another artifact quota admission.
Check original completed request before source reread/re-execution; unresolved intent requires explicit cancellation/fencing.
Fence expected interrupted attempt and block stale worker result; preserve unknown interrupted usage.
Handle cancellation racing final commit; output/sample/secant overflow remains explicit.
Keep numerical imports lazy and enforce five owner paths/scopes with no new C4/C2/C7 bypass.

whole_system_review.ownership: C1 evidence, C3 model, C5 trial outputs and C6 sealed evaluation remain separate; C0 schedules C4 proposals into C5.
whole_system_review.feedback: Simulation/teacher/model agreement cannot supply independent corroboration; actor masks are rejected numerically rather than replaced with omniscient state.
whole_system_review.timing: Pinned historical model and explicit scenario clock preserve assumptions; run hashes/immutability do not establish prospective comparison.
whole_system_review.saturation: One durable worker plus finite work/output/storage admission; C1 intake does not initialize C5; hard process isolation/fairness/HA remain open.
whole_system_review.recovery: Original outcomes and explicit uncertain completion preserved; fencing is admission control, not proof of stopped CPU or exactly-once external effects.
